role: received-BOA component validation followed by retained-state availability diagnosis; no historical controller rollout
registration_context: six pending-PN fixtures observed: five physically feasible, two service successes, one known commitment failure; received-BOA availability outcomes at V5 saved states unobserved
information_contract: Build the mandatory reference from latest already received covering BOAs, otherwise the two locked PN half-hours; no future receipt used
Preserve already accepted power outside an explicitly replacing new BOA; no instruction follows the mandatory reference

A new hypothetical BOA uses absolute endpoints, starts at current reference power and returns to the reference power at minute 32; replacement during its own interval is explicit, not an added power increment
Service capacity remains relative to the locked PN, not an extra reserve stacked on top of an already accepted activation
Use exact continuous stock bounds and gross site power through the whole known 60-minute prefix, including accepted commitments after pulse expiry
A known unsafe mandatory reference remains a commitment failure; request rejection or under-declaration does not become service success
The pulse admission rectangle and common scaling remain conservative simulation assumptions, not market-dispatch identification

component_fixtures.scope: four explicit fixtures; neither their powers nor inventories are represented as historical plant measurements

retained_state_diagnosis.state: original decision_SOC_MWh and pending_MW from retained V5 contexts; no state fitting or new controller rollout
retained_state_diagnosis.probe_scope: 292 fixed capacity stress probes at dependent nomination states; 49 MW is an analyst diagnostic input, not a measured obligation imposed on the historical plant
retained_state_diagnosis.procedure: reconstruct the already received mandatory 60-minute reference, verify it, then compute capacity and replay each requested full-service pulse from that saved state
retained_state_diagnosis.report: retain all component cases and all 292 probe rows, distinguishing unsafe reference, physical feasibility, capacity shortfall and request shortfall; report correlated state/event counts
retained_state_diagnosis.storage: only component fixtures retain full short traces; historical probes retain compact metrics and provenance, not new weekly trajectories

decision: repair reference or revision discrepancies before historical-state interpretation; after diagnosis decide whether this contract supports a bounded causal pilot. No source comparison or universal policy-impossibility claim follows from a conservative capacity shortfall
